no_adcom_quote.quote: The safety issues associated with PDE5 inhibitor therapies are well known and can be adequately labeled. In addition, no new safety concerns were identified for avanafil. Therefore, no Advisory Committee was convened.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for STENDRA (avanafil), NDA202276. The review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review) consistently state that because avanafil is a PDE5 inhibitor with efficacy and safety profiles comparable to already-marketed PDE5 inhibitors, no new safety concerns were raised and no unresolved review issues existed, so an AdComm meeting was not held. Consequently there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
